subject: Physics

subtopic: Identify and interpret the depicted apparatus
question: The displayed scale is initially balanced with its knife edge exactly under its own centre of gravity and m1=2m2. The point of suspension of m1 is shifted 1 cm toward the knife edge, remaining on its original side of the pivot. Which shift of m2 restores balance if the knife edge stays fixed? Refer to experimental arrangement 04.

options.A: Move m2 2 cm to the right
options.B: Move m2 1 cm to the left
options.C: Move m2 2 cm to the left
options.D: Move m2 1 cm to the right

correct_answer: Move m2 2 cm to the left
explanation: The drawing places m1 to the left of the knife edge and m2 to the right. Moving m1 toward the knife edge means moving it rightward by 1 cm. With the pivot fixed, the change in total gravitational moment is zero only if m1 Δx1+m2 Δx2=0, taking right as positive. Since m1=2m2 and Δx1=+1 cm, Δx2=−2 cm: m2 must move 2 cm to the left, toward the pivot. If the depicted mass positions were reversed, the same inward movement of m1 would instead require m2 to move rightward; the figure supplies the necessary orientation.
